name: Clifford Attractor
desc: A Clifford strange attractor iterated tens of thousands of points per frame into a silky log-density cloud threaded with delicate moire striations, its four coefficients drifting so the whole filigree form morphs and slowly turns, glowing indigo-to-gold on dark or recast as magenta-cyan plasma, blackbody ember, teal bioluminescence, or graphite pencil on cream.

energy.doc: exposure / glow amplitude + iteration count (primary look control)

scale.doc: attractor zoom vs frame (higher = bigger filamentary cloud)

density.doc: points iterated per frame (cloud fullness / moire richness)

gamma.doc: tone-map gamma (higher lifts faint tendrils into view)

persist.doc: accumulator smoothing (0 = crisp/live, high = long silky smear)

style.doc: render philosophy: indigo->gold silk density / magenta-cyan plasma / blackbody ember / teal bioluminescent / graphite pencil on cream

alpha.doc: opacity for VJ compositing (100 = opaque bg, lower = translucent field)
